action_legality_checks.policy_evidence: Policy: Only one tool call per turn is allowed. 'You should at most make one tool call at a time, and if you take a tool call, you should not respond to the user at the same time.'
action_legality_checks.conversation_evidence: Turn [17]: Two WRITE_ACTIONs (cancel_pending_order) were made in the same turn for different orders.
action_legality_checks.reasoning: Cardinality-only issue; action legality remains legal. Original judge reasoning: Although both cancellation actions are individually permitted and fully authorized, the policy strictly requires only one tool call per turn. Making two cancellation tool calls in the same turn violates the turn protocol.
action_legality_checks.correct_action: The assistant should have issued only one cancel_pending_order tool call in this turn, then waited for the result before proceeding with the next cancellation in a subsequent turn.
